main_topics.reason: The user came asking whether widening part and thinning were from PCOS, and the whole conversation revolves around it.
The user asked what can be done and whether it is permanent, spending several turns on minoxidil and anti-androgens.
The user asked whether it was PCOS or something else and explored stress-related shedding.
The user asked if spironolactone is safe and said they were nervous about hormone medications.
The user asked who to see and what to say so they are taken seriously, over two turns.
The user said the widening part freaks them out and asked if it will keep getting worse; they later said they were scared nothing could be done.
Thyroid, iron and vitamin tests were discussed as a way to sort out causes and the user planned to ask for them.
The user asked in one exchange whether to see a GP or dermatologist.
The user asked in one turn whether certain foods help.
The user asked in one turn whether to stop straightening while waiting.
Mentioned once as a possible trigger for shedding.

output.summary: The user with PCOS asked whether gradual hair thinning and a widening part came from PCOS or something else. The bot explained possible causes, treatment options, medication safety, who to see and how to prepare for the appointment. The user said it helped a lot and planned to book an appointment that week.
